## Checklist

- [ ] A failing test came first (rules: a test for the check or the registry entry)
- [ ] `npm run verify` is green
- [ ] New or changed rule: rationale, hint and level are set; `npm run docs` was run
- [ ] A rule moving to `must` has a fleet impact analysis in the PR description
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
